messages.text:
"The game is called Star-Flyer, a game where there is a shiny little star in space, featuring platformer spots that the star must jump across by pressing the screen. These spots are either planets, asteroids, pieces of miscellaneous terrain, rocks, and things like that, accompanied by catchy yet atmospheric music, background radioactive ambiance, and vibrations from the solar system's planets—which can appear and are made up, of various types—with the Sun shining brightly in the distant background. Everything in the game needs to be quite realistic. The further you progress, the harder the path becomes. There is a high score displayed in the top left corner, and a menu featuring the game's title in the upper middle, the name 'LeoMegaWorks Studios' in the bottom right, and an 'Exit' button as well as a 'Start Game' button. This leads to 20 game levels, designed to be variable in various ways—such as the main player-controlled star collecting diamonds scattered around the platform from time to time, or other rare gems of various kinds, or small rock 'shards' for bonus points, or even rarely astronauts that happen to be in the way, and so on

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
